---
name: Bug Report
about: Report a bug or unexpected behaviour
title: "[bug] "
labels: bug
---

## Description

A clear description of the bug.

## Reproduction

The exact command(s) you ran:

```bash
wparc ping example.com --verbose
```

Include `--verbose` output if available.

## Expected Behaviour

What you expected to happen.

## Actual Behaviour

What actually happened (error message, stack trace, screenshot).

## Environment

- wparc version (`pip show wparc`)
- Python version (`python --version`)
- OS (e.g., macOS 14, Ubuntu 22.04, Windows 11)
- WordPress site URL (if public and relevant)

## Additional Context

Anything else that might help — related issues, workarounds, network
setup, etc.
